decision:
文 becomes a name in the 經 (form 古, single character; cluster C08, 识、知、察与验; marked 讀（AI）). Its decision record takes the next free number in DELEGATED-CHOICES, currently D63. 文 names the course, the object every knowing law of 篇九 is stated on. Nothing names that object today: the 歷 row reads 「历程」 as 历之程 and gives it no name. Two rows are added to the name table (文, 文同) and five are changed (往, 歷, 理, 終而復始, 不測). Everything below is a proposal; no file was edited and no new Lean is needed.

Proposed 經, to be added to the 中华本 by proposal. The defining sentences go best into 一·二十 (观), right after 读 and 观; the 文同 law goes into 一·二十一; 篇九 then opens its knowing line with 文.

「文，一历之状经一象逐步之值也。凡逐步之值皆文：以每步至其次步为法、以此值为象，二步同，恰当自二步起逐步之值皆同；二步同，则其次步亦同：文之状与其法皆自文读出，不须给状。法之一行，其文之二步同，恰当法经此象示之，此二步之状同。二状于一法经一象，其文逐步皆同，谓之文同；法经一象示之，二状同，恰当文同。」

五·六 becomes 「往，文至某步之前段也。」

Lean anchors (all in the pure core):
- Definitions: Becoming.Parting.course, and Becoming.Learnable.course from a configuration under a law.
- 文同 is Becoming.Law.SameFuture.
- States and law read off the 文: Becoming.SameAhead, Becoming.alike_moments_iff, Becoming.SameAhead.next.
- Under a law: Becoming.IdentificationRuns.sameAhead_iff_alike, Becoming.Law.alike_iff_sameFuture.
- Bounds: Becoming.finitely_many_states_iff, Becoming.Identification.sameAhead_iff_below, Becoming.Identification.bounded_agree_exact, Becoming.Law.sameFuture_iff_within.

Name quotation: 「通其变，遂成天下之文」@DS02 (exact hit with ctq.py). In the table's own vocabulary, 通 is "the run continues" (Onward.run_iff_continues) and 变 is "process". So the clause says a 文 forms only along a run of a continuing process (相合). The companion clause 「极其数，遂定天下之象」 reads as "where a bound is given, a finite 往 fixes the 文's states" (定域).

The resulting line, one checked law per step:
- 文 → 往 (prefix of a 文) → 知来 / 符 / 得 / 阙 (all stated on a 文) → 过则改 → 终而复始 (a property of a 文) → 有界则往定其行 → 可知 (through 文同) → 衢 (two runs' 文 part) → 不测 (the diagonal 文) → 读不尽其所读.
- 类, 理 and 推类 are read off the 文 and are not the 文: the coarsest 类 that keeps the map's values and carries the law merges exactly the configurations whose 文 agree.
- 识 is a formation reading its own course through its couplings, inside the unfolding.

The written-sign layer (文字) stays with 名, 码 and 义项. A written text is a 文 of 名 read through a 码; 文 does not name the sign.

rows.name: 文
rows.what: 文（course）：一历之状经一象逐步之值（Parting.course reg r n = reg (r.state n)；法下自一状起者 Learnable.course next reg s n = reg (orbit next s n)）；凡逐步之值（o : Nat → O）皆文，其状与法自文读出，不须给状
rows.note: 所取之义：一历之状经一象逐步之值（讀，AI；须一决定记录）。文只给值，不给状与动。凡逐步之值皆文：以每步至其次步为法、以此值为象，二步同恰当自二步起逐步之值皆同（alike_moments_iff，近于定义）；二步同则其次步亦同（SameAhead.next）：文之状与法皆自文读出，无文外之立法者，与凡历皆其自然之法之行（Shown.run）同构。实质之律：法之一行，其文之二步同，恰当法经此象示之此二步之状同（IdentificationRuns.sameAhead_iff_alike）；文之状有穷，恰当有二异步同，即其值自某步起复（finitely_many_states_iff）；每步皆与前 N 步之一同者，二步同恰当自二步起 N＋N－1 步之值皆同（Identification.sameAhead_iff_below），此长对每二界皆确切（bounded_agree_exact）。篇九之知皆在文上：往是文之前段，知来自往出值，符、不符、得、阙皆在文上，终而复始是文之性质，不测是对角之文，衢是二行之文于某步分。读书百遍之条件即此：重读同一往不增所见；给界，则有穷之往定文之状；不给界，则无往定其次值（Learning.no_prefix_fixes_next）。系辞上「参伍以变，错综其数，通其变，遂成天下之文，极其数，遂定天下之象」〔DS02〕：通（名表：行之可续）其变（名表：过程），文乃成，即文只沿行而成（相合）；「极其数，遂定天下之象」读作给界则有穷之往定文之状（定域：界须所给）；揲蓍之「参伍」「错综」，与同章「遂知来物」（九·三十，相分），皆不带。对照：系辞下「物相杂，故曰文」〔DS03〕定域：文分其步只在其值有异处，每值皆新则每步自为一状（SameAhead.new_each）；一卦六爻同时之杂是一状（卦），不是文；同句「文不当，故吉凶生焉」仍相分（YI-ZHUAN p-wen-budang 不改）。贲彖「剛柔交錯，天文也……觀乎天文，以察時變」〔YD-JP22〕定域：读文得其状与法，有界方定；观、察、时于此是常语，不带名表之观（视图）、察（敏感性）、时（情境）；交错（Interleavings）、错（互补）不由此借；「觀乎人文，以化成天下」不带。荀子正名「累而成文，名之丽也」〔RU2-S-XZ22〕：一书是名经码之文；文不名符号，符号及其组合归名、码、义项（十·九知名之对照不改）。所不带：文饰、文采；文德、文治、谥号之文；人文化成；文质（文为质外之饰：状自文读出，文下无质）；天文作占；文字及《说文》文／字之分；荀子礼论之文理；吉凶。不取：历程（作名则与历混：历给状与动，文只给值，其状自读出；称之历程，又误示状已给）；序（名表已名所给之序）；像（一者之值：文于一步之值即其像）；迹（所以迹不采）。分工：同一序列，作所给之状与动则为历（其律为自然之法），作所读之值而自读其状则为文；象是映射；状值是每状之值；类、理自文读出而非文（见理）；自一状所许之历程与其后所能然之辞皆同（SameTests）者，不名文同，仍依一·二十二写之。所依之拟：步为共同之自然数索引；值以相等相比；界须所给；可知等律依一族尽其状之宇。须改写（经）：五·六「往，历程至某步之前段也」改「往，文至某步之前段也」；九·三十、九·三十一、九·三十二、九·三十三经中作逐步之值之「历程」（凡十七处）改「文」；他处「历程」（一·二十二、八·八之动之串，八·十一、九·三十七之诸历程，九·十、九·十九、九·二十二、十一·十、十一·二十四、十二·十一、十四·九之流与历，识之进一步历程）读作历之程，不改；凡例经中「古文」（凡·十九、二十六、二十七、二十八）改「古书」，免一字二义；十三·二十经「文法」改「语法」。

rows.name: 文同
rows.what: 文＋同：二状于一法经一象，其文逐步皆同（Law.SameFuture next o s s'：∀ n, o (orbit next s n) = o (orbit next s' n)，即二状之 Learnable.course 逐步相等）（same course through a map under a law）
rows.note: 新组合：文＋同，与经中「类同」同式。法经一象示之，二状同恰当文同（Law.alike_iff_sameFuture）；文同含当步之值（n = 0），旧写「其后每步」于此不明。状闭于一族之中者，文同恰当其文于族之员数减一步之前皆同，不须判定值之同异（Law.sameFuture_iff_within）。凡守象之值而为理之类，所并之二状皆文同（Law.sameFuture_of_law）；守象之值、为理而并凡文同之状者为正名（Law.identifiesAlike_of_law）。类之同异定然否，于一族尽其状之宇：一状值经一类可知，恰当凡经此类文同之二状其状值自某步起皆同（Learnable.learnable_iff）。不写「同文」：篇十「书同文」是制名之码。文同只在法经一象之下：一般之系辞，自二状所许之历程与其后所能然之辞皆同（SameTests）者不必同（Choosing.not_alike），不名文同。经中三见（一·二十一、九·三十三、九·三十五），故立名。须改写（经）：一·二十一「恰当经此象其后每步之值皆同」改「恰当其文同」；九·三十三「族中二状经类同其来，恰当其来经类于族之员数减一步之前皆同」改「族中二状经类文同，恰当其文经类于族之员数减一步之前皆同」；九·三十五「凡经此类同其来之二状」「经类同来之二状」改「凡经此类文同之二状」「经类文同之二状」。

rows.name: 往
rows.what: 文之前段（course prefix）：文至某步之前之值
rows.note: 往只指文之前段（Learning.prefixOf，最近者在前）。一行之往（Run.Fixes：于某步之前之诸移）是其诸移（状、动、次状）逐步所成之文之前段；经 π 读之者（Run.FixesThrough）是其经类之文之前段。「过此以往」（此后）与「不保其往」二读不入；带着历史名「藏往」。本次改（WL）：所名去「记录」（依錄之注：录是证之一员，往是全段）；「历程之前段」改「文之前段」（文，见文）；五·六经同改。

rows.name: 歷
rows.what: 沿步之状与动之任一序列，不问它是否为某变所许（history: any sequence of configurations and moves (g : Nat →）
rows.note: 所取之义：沿步之状与动之任一序列，不问它是否为某变所许。凡历皆其自然之法之行（Shown.run），自然之法是以此历为行之最小之变（shown_le_iff）；行是为某变所许之历。积之历（Nat → C → Nat，level path）是历之一种，取代稿中「水平之路」「水平之历」；SelectionPool 稿中已以历名积之历。孟子万章上「历年多」：历为逐一经过（先秦）。所不带：历法、历数（曆，简体并为历）、历史之人事叙事义、阅历之个人义。三家所同。nat 键其余诸义不在此名：步标之辞 p : Nat → Prop（C03 之所然）、感之日程（on : Nat → Bool）、员之量（a : α → Nat）另定；作逐步之值而自读其状者，皆文。本次改（WL）：原注末句「稿中「历程」（course，名表识、往之所名亦用）读作历之程，不另立名，也不与历混为一名」改为：作逐步之值（o : Nat → O，一历经一象，状不给而自读出）之「历程」今名文（见文）；他处「历程」（动之串、流之程、反事实之程、识之进一步历程）仍读作历之程，不另立名。同一序列，作所给之状与动则为历，作所读之值而自读其状则为文，二名不混。

rows.name: 理
rows.what: 理：对结构与变化之律的建模
rows.note: 已采；凡理皆类，类不皆理；不带「理先气后」；先秦给「分」（解老），魏晋注给「变化」（韩康伯「盡聚散之理」）；携带律是理论另加的条件。本次改（WL）：文既立名，引文「理者，成物之文也」〔CV1-S-JL〕读作定域：理是自文读出之类，不是文。法经一象示之，凡守象之值而为理之类所并之二状皆文同（Law.sameFuture_of_law）；守象之值、为理而并凡文同之状者为正名（Law.identifiesAlike_of_law）。于此最粗之理，理与文所分者同，「物有理，不可以相薄」〔CV1-S-JL〕即理不并文异之状；此是四条已检之律之合，非一条定理。

rows.name: 終而復始
rows.what: 套索（lasso）：文自某步起每隔定数之步而复
rows.note: 套索是文之性质；环是耦合之回路；复是构形之返回。文之状有穷，恰当其为套索（finitely_many_states_iff_lasso）。本次改（WL）：「历程」与所名「套索程」改「文」（文，见文）。

rows.name: 不測
rows.what: 对角之文（diagonal course）：于其上一外推所出之每值皆不符
rows.note: 沿用易章；阴阳、神之义不入。本次改（WL）：所名「对角序列」改「对角之文」（文，见文；序已名所给之序，不作序列）。

reasons:
1. It names the object the epistemology reads. Every knowing law of 篇九 is stated on o : Nat → O. Learning.lean's own docstring says "A course is a sequence of values, such as a determined law's orbit read through a map", and that sequence is what each of these is defined on: prefixOf (往), MissesAt and Accords (符), no_prefix_fixes_next, diagonal (不测), Lasso (终而复始), Identification.bounded_agree (有界则往定其行), Parting.PartAt (衢) and Learnable.course (可知). The 中华本 calls this object 「历程」 in 18 places in its 經, and nothing in the table names it. Calling it 历程 also gives the wrong meaning: it implies a 歷 whose configurations and moves are given, while the point of the course is that its states are read off it. So this is naming an unnamed concept at claim time (board item WL), not a sweep to a "better word".

2. Internally generative explanation is a law about this object. A 文's states and its law are read off the 文 itself, with no configuration given (alike_moments_iff, SameAhead.next). The canonical chapter calls alike_moments_iff "close to definitional", so the substance lies elsewhere:
   - Under a law, the 文's states are exactly the configurations alike through the map (IdentificationRuns.sameAhead_iff_alike).
   - Its states are finitely many exactly where it repeats (finitely_many_states_iff).
   - With N states, N+N−1 steps decide them (sameAhead_iff_below), and that length is exact for every pair of bounds (bounded_agree_exact).

3. 读书百遍其义自见 gets its exact condition and its failure:
   - Rereading the same 往 adds nothing; a given bound lets a finite 往 fix the states.
   - Without a bound, no 往 fixes the next value (no_prefix_fixes_next), every 知来 has its diagonal 文 (diagonal_misses), and at a 衢 no extrapolation is right on both runs (not_right_on_both).
   - What can be learned through a 类 is exactly what 文同 configurations share from some step on (learnable_iff).
   - At the text layer, a name's sense is read exactly where the records separate it (CrossSituational.reads_every_iff). These are different manifestations, which is Ren's "different manifestations of shared relations", not repetition.
   - A rival meaning is never ruled out while every bearing record has a world of that meaning explaining it, so the name does not resolve (CrossSituational.resolves_explained_iff). This is the exact form of an explanation terminating outside, such as a will that explains any record.

4. Compression and generalization coincide. The coarsest 类 that keeps the map's values and carries the law merges exactly the 文同 configurations, and it is the 正名 (Law.identifiesAlike_of_law, with Law.sameFuture_of_law).

5. The classical evidence fits in the table's own words. In 「通其变，遂成天下之文，极其数，遂定天下之象」 (DS02), 通 (the run continues), 变 (process), 数 (count) and 象 (model) are all adopted names. Read that way, the sentence states the two laws: a 文 forms along a run, and the count's bound fixes the model. The rest of the evidence sits as follows:
   - 「物相杂，故曰文」 (DS03) is 定域. Its synchronic mixture is a 卦, which the table already names as a configuration.
   - 「觀乎天文，以察時變」 (YD-JP22) is 定域; its 观, 察 and 时 are ordinary words here.
   - 「累而成文」 (RU2-S-XZ22) places texts as 文 of 名.

6. No duplicate and no collision:
   - 文 differs from 状, 象, 像 (the edition's 「其像」 is a writing convention, not a name), 类, 理, 读 (the act whose output along steps is the 文), 辨, 名, 码, 义项 and 符.
   - It also differs from 歷 (states and moves given) and from 往 (its prefix).
   - Neither 文 nor 文同 equals or contains any adopted name once simplified. 文 is absent from names-decisions.tsv, symbols-not-adopted.tsv and names-dropped.tsv.
   - The draft 經 avoids 序 (a name for order), 得 and 予 (both names), and does not use 像.

7. Nonduality. 文 is not a surface over a substance: the 状 are read off the 文, and the 文 is a 歷 read through a 象, which is itself a relation. Knowing stays inside the unfolding (识, Web.SelectsThrough), not in a meta-level 观/证 mirror.

8. Convergence with 文理生生. Its working definition of 文 is 「有差异的成分，在一定关系与时序中呈现出的可辨样态」, and its 文¹ takes a state through a feature scheme; both land on 文. 文² lands on 名, 码 and 义项, a written text being a 文 of 名. 文³ lands on 象 and 理. Its rule that text, representation and world object are not coerced into one another is kept.

Verification:
- ctq.py text gave exact hits for DS02 「通其变，遂成天下之文」, 「极其数，遂定天下之象」, 「推而行之谓之通」 and 「化而裁之谓之变」; DS03 「物相杂，故曰文」 and 「彰往而察来」; YD-JP22 「觀乎天文，以察時變」 and 「剛柔交錯，天文也」; CV1-S-JL 「理者，成物之文也」; RU2-S-XZ22 「累而成文，名之丽也」; and RU2-S-XZ05 「類不悖，雖久同理」.
- 读书百遍 is not in the corpus (0 hits), so it is not cited.
- Every anchor resolved with resolve.py: the rows' anchors, Run.Fixes, Run.FixesThrough and the supporting CrossSituational, Segmentation and Onward laws.
- The anchors' modules are core modules in receipt becoming-checks/20261022T040548.209667Z (status passed, kernel checked), and every anchor declaration has an empty axiom report.

Limits:
- The model fixes a discrete shared step index, compares values by equality, and needs a supplied bound N. Learnability needs a world a list holds and decided equality of classes.
- "Same 理 exactly where same 文" combines four checked theorems; no single theorem states it.
- No theorem joins the course laws to CrossSituational or to Web.AlikeThroughUpTo. Both are candidate Lean items that need a board claim, and neither is claimed here.
rejected:
- **Lens 2, Way 1: 文 = what a configuration answers to all tests (文同 = SameTests).** Rejected for four reasons:
  - (a) SameTests is a relation between configurations. "The 文" as an object would need a quotient (Quot.sound), so 往 cannot be its prefix, and 知来, 符, 终而复始, 衢 and 不测 are not stated on it. The knowing line would lose its object.
  - (b) It nearly restates what 一·二十二 already says of 状: 「状即其所以相关：然哪些辞、能以哪些动走到哪里」. Under a determined frame it coincides with 同 (alike_iff_sameTests).
  - (c) Its 物相杂 grade, the joint tests in Composition, has no record.
  - (d) It makes 文 a configuration's total answer, a meta-level object.
  - Its finding stands as a separate open item: SameTests appears in several 經 wordings and may get its own name later, but not 文. Under a law read through a map it is exactly 文同.
- **Lens 2, Way 3: name only Law.SameFuture.** Kept, as the 文同 row under the course name, not as the meaning of 文.
- **Role term for the edition's text layer (lens 1 proposal 2, lens 2 way 2, lens 3 way 3).** Rejected:
  - It carries no law of its own; every law it would cite belongs to 码 and 名.
  - It duplicates 码 and the register already called 文言.
  - It places 文 at the meta level, the place of 文理生生's 观/证 mirror, while the core puts knowing inside the unfolding (识).
  - 文 has no second written form to separate a role term from a name, so taking it as a role term would block the concept name.
  - Under the adopted name, a text is already an instance: a 文 of 名 read through a 码.
- **Not a name (lens 1 proposal 3).** Rejected. It leaves unnamed the centre that was asked for, while an exact structure with checked laws exists. The many senses of 文 are handled by the 所不带 list, as for every other classical name.
- **Split 类/文 (lens 3 way 2).** Rejected:
  - It gives one map two names, admissible only as a role pair.
  - It collides with 辨, 分 and 别.
  - It leaves the course unnamed.
  - Its content survives as Law.sameFuture_of_law in the 理 row.
- **Corrections to the lenses' version of the adopted course reading (lens 1 proposal 1, lens 3 way 1):**
  - The name's quotation is DS02 「通其变，遂成天下之文」, not 「物相杂，故曰文」. The latter's passage is read 相分, and its mixture is synchronic: a 卦, which is a configuration.
  - 物相杂 and 觀乎天文 are 定域, not 相合. 观, 察 and 时 are names with other senses, and fixing the states needs a bound.
  - 「理者，成物之文也」 is 定域, because carrying a law and coarsest are added conditions. The 理 row has to say so, since its quotation now contains a name.
  - The 經 avoids 像, 序, 得, 予 and 「同类」 for states.
  - alike_moments_iff is flagged as near-definitional; the substance is in sameAhead_iff_alike and in the bounds.
  - The 往 row must also cover Run.Fixes and Run.FixesThrough, the run's record.
  - Only the 18 course occurrences of 历程 change; the move-sequence and flow uses stay.
- **Quotations not used in the rows.** Lens 1 checked 「物一無文」 (国语) and the 说文 quotations by script against the repository's frozen files, not with ctq.py, so they are not used in the rows.
- **The character 迹.** Not adopted (所以迹 is not adopted), and not needed.
